_note: Input definitions (data) in the knowledge base of the initial demo state. In the full system these are KB elements that travel with updates; in the demo they are kept as a data file, not code. Fields: key (bucket.key read by rules), label, help, type (money|int|bool|choice|flag), group (pegawai|perusahaan|bulanan), order, core (always shown), repeat (monthly: repeats every month), default, options / options_from (table:<name> or usage), show_if, valid_from, valid_until, replaces, source.

defs.label: Marital status for PTKP on 1 January
defs.help: TK = unmarried, K = married; the number is the number of dependents. The status on 1 January applies for the whole year; marriage or a new child during the year only counts from next year.

defs.label: Sex
defs.help: Used by the PTKP rule for married female employees.

defs.label: Statement that the husband has no income
defs.help: A married female employee uses the unmarried PTKP unless there is this statement.

defs.label: How the tax is paid
defs.help: Gross: withheld from salary. Gross-up: the company gives a tax allowance equal to the PPh. Borne: the company pays the tax without an allowance.

defs.label: NIK / NPWP registered
defs.help: Condition for the DTP incentive.

defs.label: Employee is also a shareholder
defs.help: A company car for a shareholder is always a taxable in-kind benefit (natura).

defs.label: Average monthly gross, last 12 months
defs.help: A company car is taxable when this average is above the limit. Empty: that month's base salary + fixed allowance is used.

defs.label: Fixed income under the contract
defs.help: For new employees: the DTP income limit uses the fixed income in the employment contract.

defs.label: Already receives another DTP incentive
defs.help: If yes, this DTP does not apply.

defs.label: Became a taxpayer in Indonesia (month)
defs.help: Only for employees who came from abroad this year; their tax is annualized.

defs.label: Stopped being a taxpayer in Indonesia (month)
defs.help: Only for employees who moved abroad or died this year.

defs.label: Last month of work, already certain
defs.help: For employees who are certain to leave.

defs.label: Line of business (KLU, 5 digits)
defs.help: Business sector classification code of the company; it decides eligibility for the DTP incentive.

defs.label: Job risk (JKK)
defs.help: Risk level that sets the JKK premium rate.

defs.label: Eligible for JKK contribution relief
defs.help: Certain labor-intensive industries.

defs.label: BPJS contributions follow the bill
defs.help: If yes, contributions and premiums are entered monthly as billed by BPJS; if not, they are computed from wages.

defs.label: Value of meals at the workplace
defs.help: For the limit on meal coupons for field duty.

defs.label: Base salary
defs.help: Base salary paid that month (already prorated for joining, leaving, or a raise in mid-month).

defs.label: Monthly fixed allowance
defs.help: Allowances paid at a fixed amount every month, e.g. position, family, phone, transport allowance.

defs.label: Overtime pay
defs.help: Overtime pay paid that month. Under the regulation it counts as regular income even though the amount varies.

defs.label: Other regular pay (meal allowance, cash transport, etc.)
defs.help: Other pay received regularly, e.g. daily meal allowance or cash transport.

defs.label: THR
defs.help: Religious holiday allowance (THR) paid that month.

defs.label: Bonus
defs.help: Bonus paid that month.

defs.label: Occasional incentive, compensation, or back pay
defs.help: Pay that is not received regularly, e.g. quarterly sales incentive, compensation, back pay for a raise.

defs.label: Other salary deductions
defs.help: Deductions other than tax and contributions (loans, fines).

defs.label: Employee JHT contribution (BPJS bill)
defs.help: Fill in when contributions follow the BPJS bill.

defs.label: Employee JP contribution (BPJS bill)
defs.help: Fill in when contributions follow the BPJS bill.

defs.label: Employee BPJS Kesehatan contribution (bill)
defs.help: Fill in when contributions follow the BPJS bill.

defs.label: JKK premium (BPJS bill)
defs.help: Fill in when the premium follows the BPJS bill.

defs.label: JKM premium (BPJS bill)
defs.help: Fill in when the premium follows the BPJS bill.

defs.label: Company BPJS Kesehatan contribution (bill)
defs.help: Fill in when contributions follow the BPJS bill.

defs.label: Company car (monthly value)
defs.help: Monthly value of using a company car. Taxable only in certain situations; the rules decide.

defs.label: Company housing for one employee (monthly value)
defs.help: Monthly value of the company housing.

defs.label: Gift other than for a religious holiday
defs.help: Value of the gift received that month.

defs.label: Meal coupon for field duty
defs.help: Value of meal coupons for employees on field duty.

defs.label: Sports facility
defs.help: Value of the sports facility received that month.

defs.label: Other goods or facilities (in-kind, natura)
defs.help: Other in-kind benefits received, e.g. a scholarship from the company.

defs.label: Zakat through the company
defs.help: Zakat or compulsory religious donation withheld through the company that month.

defs.label: THR paid this month
defs.help: Tick in the month THR is paid (not the month of the holiday). Used to check the minimum THR and by company policies that compute THR.

defs.label: Length of service (months)
defs.help: Continuous length of service up to that month, in months. Decides the minimum THR (1 month's wage for 12 months of service or more, proportional below that).

defs.label: Days since leaving before the holiday
defs.help: Fill in only if the employee left within 30 days before the holiday; the employee is still entitled to THR.
